ports.label: Multiviewer Out
ports.note: 2x HDMI 2.0, or 2x DisplayPort 1.2 with the optional card

ports.label: Frame Lock In
ports.note: Analog frame lock input; connector type not stated in the sources reviewed

ports.label: Frame Lock Loop Out
ports.note: Analog frame lock loop output; connector type not stated in the sources reviewed

ports.label: Tally / GPI-O (MCO 5-pin)
ports.note: From the LivePremier manual: 1x On/Off, 2x GPI, 8x GPO. 3 MCO 5-pin mating connectors are supplied

ports.label: Ethernet Control
ports.note: Unit control via Web RCS or API; default IP 192.168.2.140

ports.label: USB
ports.note: Quick start guide gives only '2 x USB plugs'; connector type and location are not confirmed

slots.label: Input connector cards
slots.note: Field swappable; shipped with 16x HDMI 2.0, 8x DP 1.2 and 8x 12G-SDI. Optional cards: HDMI 1.4, NDI+12G-SDI, SFP+, optical, SDVoE

slots.label: Output connector cards
slots.note: Field swappable; shipped with 20x HDMI 2.0. Optional: DP 1.2, 12G-SDI, SFP+, optical, SDVoE

notes: IA — non confirmé : typ_w (typical power consumption is not published; only max 1300 W), power_connector (the inlet type is not stated in the datasheet or quick start guide; 3 power cords are supplied), side (front/rear) of every port group is assumed to be rear and was not confirmed against the panel drawing, Frame Lock connector type (assumed BNC), USB connector type and location (assumed USB-A; guide only says '2 x USB plugs'), Tally/GPIO connector type (MCO 5-pin from the LivePremier manual, mapped to phoenix), max_w discrepancy: quick start guide says 1010 W, datasheet says 1300 W (datasheet used)
